_comment: Claude Code settings for the gaffer factory delivery agent. SECURITY: the PreToolUse hook (safety-hook.mjs) is the real boundary — it deterministically blocks force-push, protected-branch pushes, dependency installs, secret-file reads/writes, and out-of-repo writes BEFORE they run. Every file-touching tool in permissions.allow (Bash, Write/Edit, Read, Grep/Glob) MUST have a PreToolUse matcher here — Grep and Glob read file contents too (test/claude-settings.test.mjs pins this). The Read deny rules are recursive (**/) or absolute (//, ~/) on purpose: Claude Code turns them into ripgrep excludes for Grep/Glob, and a ./-anchored rule only covers the cwd root. The permissions.allow list below is intentionally broad so the headless agent isn't stuck on prompts; the hook (not the allow-list) is what keeps it safe. Review/tighten allow for your environment before an unattended run. NOTE: permission/tool-pattern syntax can vary by Claude Code version — verify with `claude --help` and a single supervised run first.
